data.summary: Fresh controls-guided MAX investigation; earlier failed attempt remains separate.

Compilation and dependency cache reused from the same untouched pre-fix revision and worker image. Copied offline baseline evidence retains its original timestamp. New model context; every gameplay replay starts with a fresh profile. No new build or test execution is claimed by this reuse.
Unverified player report: on Windows build 27713, a unit allegedly "disappears" after being directed into a payload conveyor.
Restored the registered input files before this fresh game launch.
Testing the player report in the historical game build.

data.statement: A selected Dagger commanded to enter the prepared connected payload-conveyor route will be transported through it and emerge rather than be lost.

data.observation: The supplied save was imported and loaded in gameplay. Three vertically separated Daggers and a connected right-facing three-block payload-conveyor route were visibly identified after zooming out; the UI tooltip confirmed the Enter Payload Block command. A command-mode trial did not yield a clearly attributable entry or exit: pointer movement caused an unintended multi-unit selection and the subsequently targeted units remained visibly at their starting positions in the captured state.
